sources.notes: Aesthetic only. D concept squat layered crust and dark open throat retained. Avoid a perfectly circular wedding cake: vary radial outline and tier heights with smooth deterministic rhythm, several integrated rounded lobes on shoulder. Top aperture narrow versus broad base, deep closed-bottom throat, real inner wall thickness. No tiny separate scene base or vegetation. Palette three cream/tan crust colors plus dark throat.
